title: Approximation Families and the Statistical Efficiency of Denoising Score Matching
abstract: arXiv:2610.36205v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study score matching over finite-dimensional approximation spaces generated by gradients of eigenfunctions of the infinitesimal generator of a forward diffusion. We compare polynomial approximation under one-dimensional Ornstein-Uhlenbeck flow with trigonometric-polynomial approximation under heat flow on the torus. In the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck setting, we show that for every non-Gaussian initial distribution uniformly comparable to the standard Gaussian, the asymptotic score-estimation variance grows exponentially along a subsequence of polynomial degrees. Averaging the score-matching loss under the diffusion semigroup, which we call operator-informed score matching (OISM), reduces the variance at each fixed degree but does not eliminate this exponential instability at sufficiently small times. translated_title: 逼近族与去噪得分匹配的统计效率
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在由前向扩散过程的无穷小生成元的特征函数梯度所生成的有限维逼近空间上进行的得分匹配。我们比较了一维 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 流下的多项式逼近与环面上热流下的三角多项式逼近。在 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 设定中，我们证明：对于每一个与标准高斯分布一致可比的非高斯初始分布，渐近得分估计方差会沿多项式次数的某个子序列呈指数增长。将得分匹配损失在扩散半群下取平均——我们称之为算子信息得分匹配——可以在每个固定次数下降低方差，但在足够小的时间处并不能消除这种指数不稳定性。一个局部极小极大下界表明，当估计得分的多项式投影而非完整得分时，同样会出现这种对高次数的依赖。
tldr: 该论文证明了在 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 流下对非高斯分布进行多项式得分匹配时，得分估计方差会沿多项式次数的某个子序列指数增长，且通过扩散半群平均损失（OISM）虽能降低每一固定次数的方差，却无法在足够小的时间消除这种指数不稳定性。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that for non-Gaussian distributions under Ornstein-Uhlenbeck flow, the asymptotic variance of polynomial score estimation grows exponentially along a subsequence of polynomial degrees, and averaging the score-matching loss over the diffusion semigroup (OISM) reduces the variance at each fixed degree but fails to eliminate this exponential instability at sufficiently small times.
